stock_movements_sign_chk.name: stock_movements_sign_chk
stock_movements_sign_chk.value:
("stock_movements"."type" = 'RECEIPT' AND "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0 AND "stock_movements"."reason" IS NULL)
       OR ("stock_movements"."type" = 'ISSUE' AND "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0 AND "stock_movements"."reason" IS NULL)
       OR ("stock_movements"."type" = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND "stock_movements"."quantity" <> 0 AND "stock_movements"."reason" IS NOT NULL)

users_login_method_chk.name: users_login_method_chk
users_login_method_chk.value: ("users"."role" = 'BENEFICIARY' AND "users"."mobile" IS NOT NULL) OR ("users"."role" <> 'BENEFICIARY' AND "users"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL)
